description: workframe 推荐但不强求的 Claude Code 环境变量集合。/core:onboard skill 消费此文件呈现给用户，所有项目默认动作为 skip。

recommended_env_vars.description_zh: Agent Teams 是 Claude Code 实验功能。workframe 不依赖它：续派子 agent 用 SendMessage 发给 agentId，不需要开它。启用后带 name 的派发会变成队友，workframe 会拦下给出厂角色（core:*）起名的派发。
recommended_env_vars.description_en: Agent Teams is an experimental Claude Code feature. workframe does not depend on it: continuing a subagent works by sending SendMessage to its agentId without it. When enabled, a dispatch that sets name launches a teammate, and workframe blocks dispatches that name a built-in role (core:*).

scopes.note_zh: 仅本项目本机，不进 git
